name: sure_agent_eval
description: Evaluate an Agent (an ordered chain of approved models, e.g. ASR -> LLM translator) over speech datasets: run the chain to produce a /sure_infer-compatible prediction bundle, then score it with the pinned sure-evaluation engine.

artifacts.description: The validated agent spec with every stage resolved to its approved model binding, the resolved dataset set, and the requested metrics. Carries no credential values.
Terminal record of the chained agent execution (job_status, per-dataset counts, product directory holding the /sure_infer-compatible bundle).
Evaluation report proving source identity, the resolved pipelines, per-dataset metric scores, and the batch appended into the bundle's evaluation_runs/.
